name: Hollywood
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Hollywood, FL 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Hollywood, FL: the Candy Cane Parade, Christmas Near the Beach at ArtsPark, a holiday kickoff and a beachfront tree light-up night.
lede: Hollywood does Christmas by the sea and downtown: a Broadwalk parade of lighted floats, a beach-themed festival around a 40-foot tree at ArtsPark and a toy drive run by Hollywood Fire Rescue.
celebrates: Hollywood spreads its Christmas across the beach and downtown. The City of Hollywood Parks, Recreation and Cultural Arts department presents the Candy Cane Parade on the Hollywood Beach Broadwalk, with lighted floats, marching bands and a free concert at the Hollywood Beach Theatre afterward. Downtown, the Authentic Love Movement hosts Christmas Near the Beach at ArtsPark at Young Circle, built around a 40-foot lighted tree, a live nativity and a visit from St. Nick. Margaritaville Hollywood Beach Resort opens its lobby for a tree light-up night, and families are invited to bring a new unwrapped toy for the Hollywood Fire Rescue Toy Drive.
lastyear: In 2025 Hollywood celebrated its centennial, and the city's calendar listed a Centennial Celebration Candy Cane Parade and Concert on Saturday, December 6, 2025, from 7 to 11 pm. Christmas Near the Beach was planned for Saturday, December 13, 2025, as a free festival in downtown Hollywood from 4 to 9 pm, with a 40-foot lighted tree and live music. The city also listed a Friday tree lighting with Santa photos at ArtsPark at Young Circle, free to attend, with the lighting at 7 pm.
facts: Hollywood was officially founded in 1925. The city clerk's history page credits developer Joseph Wesley Young and covers the Hurricane of 1926 and the development boom of the 1950s through the 1970s, with Young Circle and the Hollywood Beach Casino among its topics. The Candy Cane Parade began in the mid-1950s with a group of Hollywood merchants, and the city calls it one of the longest running holiday parades in the country.
trains: Tri-Rail has two Hollywood stops: Hollywood Station at 3001 Hollywood Boulevard and Sheridan Street Station at 2900 Sheridan Street. Tri-Rail's destination list pairs the Hollywood station with Gulfstream Park, and its Fort Lauderdale Airport station at 500 Gulf Stream Way in Dania with the Seminole Hard Rock Hotel and Casino. Tri-Rail also stops at Metrorail Transfer and MiamiCentral in Miami. For a bigger train day, the Gold Coast Railroad Museum in Miami has the presidential car Ferdinand Magellan and a narrow gauge train ride.
train_links: More than 40 historic rail cars, the presidential car Ferdinand Magellan and a narrow gauge train ride in Miami.
traditions: Lighted floats, bands and decorated vehicles roll along the Hollywood Beach Broadwalk, followed by a free concert at the Hollywood Beach Theatre.
A downtown festival at ArtsPark at Young Circle with a 40-foot lighted tree, a live nativity and St. Nick.
Families drop off a new, unwrapped toy with City staff at the Hollywood Beach Theatre during the parade.
The beachfront resort lights a Christmas tree in its lobby with Santa hats, hot cocoa and face painting.
The city has lit a holiday tree at ArtsPark at Young Circle with Santa photos and free admission.
kidfact: Hollywood's Candy Cane Parade started in the 1950s, so grandparents may remember it too.
faq: Where is the Hollywood Candy Cane Parade?

It rolls along the Hollywood Beach Broadwalk, south from Missouri Street to Harrison Street, with the emcee at the Hollywood Beach Theatre on Johnson Street. The City of Hollywood says a free live concert follows at the theatre. Bring a chair, and a new unwrapped toy if you can, for the Hollywood Fire Rescue Toy Drive.
Is there a Christmas tree lighting in downtown Hollywood?

Downtown Hollywood's ArtsPark at Young Circle, 1 Young Circle, is where the city has held its holiday tree lighting with Santa photos, and where Christmas Near the Beach lights a 40-foot tree. The city lists these events on its official calendar, so check it for this year's dates.
Can kids meet Santa in Hollywood?

Yes. Christmas Near the Beach offers a free photo with St. Nick at his Beach House, per its organizers. The city's tree lighting at ArtsPark has also included Santa photos, and Margaritaville Hollywood Beach Resort lists a Mr. and Mrs. Claus appearance at its lobby light-up night.
Are Hollywood's big Christmas events free?
The Candy Cane Parade, the concert after it and Christmas Near the Beach are listed as free. The resort lobby event and some other programs do not print a price, so check the host before you go.
Which train stations are near Hollywood?

Tri-Rail serves Hollywood Station at 3001 Hollywood Boulevard and Sheridan Street Station at 2900 Sheridan Street. The Fort Lauderdale Airport station at 500 Gulf Stream Way in Dania is the Tri-Rail stop Tri-Rail lists for the Seminole Hard Rock Hotel and Casino.

The magic runs from November 29 (Hollywood Holiday Kickoff at the Hollywood Women's Club) through December 12, with Candy Cane Parade on the Hollywood Beach Broadwalk (December 5), Christmas Tree Light-Up Night at Margaritaville Hollywood Beach Resort (December 5) and Christmas Near the Beach Festival at ArtsPark (December 12) along the way. We check every date on the host’s own website, and each listing links straight there. For more nearby, see our Miami Christmas events for kids guide and the Florida Christmas events for kids guide.
